label: Identity Semantics Context
definition: Owns the canonical language for identity subjects, representations, identifiers, contexts, attributes and claims.
model_ownership: IdentitySubject; Party; DigitalIdentity; Identifier; IdentityContext; IdentityAttribute; Claim
integration_style: Published Language plus Shared Kernel for canonical identity semantics

label: Identity Assurance Context
definition: Owns evidential roles, proof use, identity binding, assurance assessment, proofing and enrollment semantics.
model_ownership: Evidence; Proof; IdentityBinding; AssuranceAssessment; IdentityProofing; Enrollment; generic Verifier
downstream_consumers: Credential Lifecycle; Authentication; Federation; Credential Exchange; Workload Identity; Device Identity; Trust Governance; Government Identity
integration_style: Customer Supplier internally; external evidence schemes via Anticorruption Layer

label: Credential Lifecycle Context

downstream_consumers: Credential Exchange; Workload Identity; Government Identity
integration_style: Published Language for credential lifecycle; standards mapped through Anticorruption Layer

label: Authentication Context
definition: Owns authentication events, authenticators, results and session semantics.
downstream_consumers: Federation; Workload Identity; Device Identity; Government Identity
integration_style: Customer Supplier; protocol adapters remain mappings

label: Authorization Context

downstream_consumers: Identity Administration; Workload Identity; Device Identity; Agent Identity
integration_style: Published Language for access semantics; vendor IAM models through Anticorruption Layer

label: Identity Administration Context
definition: Owns platform-local accounts, profiles, identity sources, stores, administrative domains, applications, provisioning and attribute mappings.
model_ownership: Account; UserProfile; IdentitySource; AuthoritativeIdentitySource; IdentityStore; AdministrativeDomain; Application; ApplicationRegistration; Provisioning; ProvisioningConnection; AttributeMapping
integration_style: Customer Supplier; external directories and vendor schemas through Anticorruption Layer

label: Federation Context
definition: Owns cross-domain federation relationships, configured federation connections, brokers and relying-party interaction semantics.
downstream_consumers: Credential Exchange; Government Identity; enterprise integration views
integration_style: Customer Supplier with Identity Administration and Authentication; standards through Anticorruption Layer

label: Credential Exchange Context
definition: Owns holder, wallet, request, presentation, controller, verification-method and selective-disclosure semantics.

label: Workload Identity Context

label: Agent Identity Context

integration_style: Conformist to canonical Core language; emerging agent frameworks through Anticorruption Layer

downstream_consumers: Federation; Credential Exchange; Workload Identity; Agent Identity; Government Identity
